get.summary: Returns the Clinical Kernel API's operational status.
Resolves a NodeRef to its summary.
get.description: Title, code and state of one kernel object in the caller's tenant, at its current version.

get.summary: The zoom path from the tenant down to an object.
get.description: Presentation only: the path never grants or implies authority (spec §9.3).

get.summary: The children of a scope node, with their own child counts.
get.description: A node the caller may not see is refused; a child the caller may not see is masked in place (ADR-2471).

get.summary: The kernel commands offered on an object, each with the caller's dry-run decision.
get.description: Each decision is the one sending the command would get now (ADR-2483), explained (ADR-2482).

get.summary: Whether the caller may exercise a capability on an object now, and why.
get.description: A dry run: it executes nothing and is recorded in the authorization access log, not the audit chain (ADR-2483).

get.summary: Finds kernel objects in the caller's tenant by code or title.
get.description: Each word matches as a prefix; an exact code ranks first. Sources that reveal identity are searched only when the caller holds the capability (ADR-2484).

get.summary: A study's protocol versions, newest first, without their content.
get.description: A study the caller may not see is refused; a version the caller may not see is masked in place (ADR-2471).

get.summary: One protocol version, without its content.
A protocol version's Schedule of Activities, compiled from its design.
get.description: Planned activities as columns grouped by epoch, collection specifications as rows (ADR-2475). A version the caller may not see is refused.

get.summary: Walks an object's lineage backward to its inputs or forward to its dependents.
get.description: direction is Backward (default) or Forward; depth 1 to 50 (default 10); edge_kind repeats (for example DerivedFrom); valid_at and known_at read the graph as it was.

get.summary: What depends on an object, grouped by kind with counts.
get.description: Masked objects are counted like any other, so a count never depends on the reader. depth 1 to 50 (default 10); edge_kind repeats; valid_at and known_at read the graph as it was.

get.summary: What depends on the version a protocol amendment changes (K-PROT-2).
What happened in a scope, newest first.
get.description: scope is any NodeRef (the whole tenant when absent); family repeats (Knowledge, Execution, Evidence, Trust, Quality, Intelligence); actor filters by who did it; from is the earliest recorded time; before is the previous page's next cursor; limit 1 to 200 (default 50). Entries about objects you may not see are masked in place.

post.summary: Evaluates a candidate USDM protocol version in memory without database changes.
Generates a complete USDM protocol proposal from a trial brief with reasoning lineage.
Performs immediate real-time matrix gap check on a candidate protocol design graph.

get.summary: An observation with its revisions, its lock and its kernel audit entries.

post.summary: Records an observation for the participant of an enrollment (observation.record).
Corrects an observation's value with the signed reason for change (observation.correct).
Locks an observation so no correction commits after it (observation.lock).
